comment: Independent C-first lawful Priest with mention_map (a11y.glyph_updates). A worn amulet of ESP makes allmain.c moveloop_core() call see_monsters() each turn. In the Valley of the Dead, debug ^F (wiz_map) maps the unexplored graves with notices blocked, leaving their gbuf entries gnew. see_monsters() then newsyms mindless undead on those graves: display.c show_glyph() reports the first through pline_xy(), whose vpline() flush_screen() clears every gnew bit, so the later graves, showing the same glyph, report nothing. C shows one '(24west): grave.' line.
